methods_quotes.q: Cases were stratified by race, sex, and age for all cancers combined
In all analyses, cells containing fewer than six cases were suppressed to protect confidentiality and reduce misinterpretation or misuse of unstable counts.
Because current national population denominators are not available for all subgroups, results are presented as frequencies and percentages rather than rates.
Percentage calculated using each racial group’s total number of cases as a denominator.
